title: Online Orders Basket Limits and Fraud Review Thresholds
content:
The size of an Online Orders order is bounded per delivery service: the highest order total the service accepts, the units one order may carry, and the order total at which the order is held for fraud review.

| Delivery service | Highest order total accepted (USD) | Units per order, at most | Units of one SKU, at most | Fraud review from order total of (USD) | Fraud review hold, at most (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 5000.00 | 25 | 5 | 2500.00 | 24 |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 5000.00 | 25 | 5 | 2500.00 | 24 |
| Standard Ground | 5000.00 | 25 | 5 | 2500.00 | 24 |
| Expedited 2-Day | 5000.00 | 25 | 5 | 2500.00 | 24 |
| Next Business Day | 5000.00 | 25 | 5 | 2500.00 | 24 |
| Same-Day Courier | 1500.00 | 25 | 5 | 2500.00 | 24 |

## Definitions

- **SKU** means one style in one colour and one size; the per-SKU limit counts units of that exact combination on one order.
- **Highest order total accepted** is the largest order total the service takes.
- **Fraud review threshold** is the order total at or above which the order is held for fraud review before release.
- **Fraud review hold** is the number of hours an order may be held for fraud review before it is cancelled if not cleared.
- Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground, Expedited 2-Day and Next Business Day carry no minimum order value (0.00).

## Worked readings (hypothetical baskets)

| Basket | Reading |
|---|---|
| 26 units in total | Above 25 units per order |
| 6 units of one dress in one colour and size | Above 5 units of one SKU |
| 5 units each of two sizes of the same dress | Two SKUs of 5 units each; within both limits |
| Same-Day Courier order totalling 1500.01 | Above the Same-Day Courier highest total of 1500.00 |
| Standard Ground order totalling 2500.00 | At the fraud review threshold, so held for review |
| Standard Ground order totalling 2499.99 | Below the fraud review threshold |

Because the Same-Day Courier highest total of 1500.00 lies below the 2500.00 fraud review threshold, an accepted Same-Day Courier order never reaches that threshold.
